application_rule: Start with base and verify SHA. Apply v2-v4 replacement_operations with expected prior tier/decision and append additions. Then apply v5 priority_operations by exact asset_kind/repo_id with expected_current_tier+decision preconditions; require 132 unique coverage. Sort by forecast_investigation_rank. Never infer approval or auto-download. Then apply v6 efficiency_operations by exact asset_kind/repo_id and assert matching v5 wave/rank/decision for all 132. Resource screening never implies runtime success or download approval. Then apply v7 parameter_gate_operations to all 109 models; verify each expected prior status and total params from source. For >=250B apply explicit exclusion replacement_operations; for null total params block final lock. Keep datasets exempt. Assert 132 unique assets and 109 param checks. Do not download. Then apply v8 total-model-parameter gate on each of 109 models, validating expected v7 decision/tier/gate. Apply one explicit new HOLD-to-EXCLUDED transition; keep previous EXCLUDED. Block final lock if unknown. Reject >=150B. Datasets exempt. Then apply v9 parameter_evidence_operations to exactly 25 prior-UNVERIFIED models, asserting per-record expected tier/decision/status, promoting only first-party documented complete published model or major inference component counts; leave 12 unknown and enforce 150B cap, independent dependency/manifest rights. Then apply v10 conditional/R1 -> hold/HOLD transition for dphn/Dolphin3.0-Llama3.1-8B with exact expected prior state. Reject blocked and excluded models from v10 candidate list. Then apply v11 seven exact preconditioned unknown-total active -> HOLD transitions; reject all active models without a verified total; candidate list must equal active IDs. Then v12 supersedes v8-v11 hard total >=150B with a 150B baseline and requires complete quantized runtime + rights + performance evidence for any larger model; two legacy excluded models move to HOLD, no auto-promotion. Data 23 unchanged. Preserve provenance and explicit approval. Then v13 append exactly two Hugging Face verified repo identities: 0bserverx ARA GGUF as conditional and afdudley reproducible NVFP4 as HOLD; require no duplicate IDs; preserve strict non-executable proposal candidate invariants and all rights checks. Then v14 apply six exact user-directed active->excluded transitions and Nanbeige conditional->select; no files deleted; candidate list must equal 92 active entries. Then v15 apply two explicit active->HOLD replacements and append five HF model records with verified metadata (four active, one HOLD); sort by forecast rank, assert 139 unique and 94 active. Alternate Pirate Face index never implies legal/peer download.
